prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: detailed production raster flowchart for a Korean ERP developer portfolio. Generate a NEW expanded diagram, replacing an earlier overly simple flowchart.

Create a precise, dense but readable technical decision flowchart showing ALL branches of a 30-combination survey access policy, plus server revalidation on changes. White canvas, large landscape or nearly square layout at high resolution, flat vector-like graphics, Korean sans serif. Grey outlined rectangles, diamonds for questions, arrowheads and explicit edge labels. Use #f5f5f5 for ordinary nodes, #dbe2ef for allowed or read-only outcomes, #112d4e text, neutral grey borders and connectors. Use red only for rejection outcomes. No icons, decoration, gradients, shadows, watermark, middle-dot punctuation, or large title; the website provides the title. Korean text must be spelled correctly. Do not simplify or omit the state branches.

TOP: three compact input nodes feeding a central processing node.
Input 1: "운영 상태 5개" with "생성, 예약, 진행, 일시정지, 종료".
Input 2: "응답 상태 3개" with "미응답, 작성 중, 제출 완료".
Input 3: "참여 대상 여부 2개" with "대상, 비대상".
Central processing node: "SQL JOIN으로 상태 조회" and "5 × 3 × 2 = 30개 입력 조합".

MAIN DECISION FLOW, exact logic:
1. Diamond "설문 대상인가요?"
NO edge "아니요" to red terminal "접근 차단" / "15개 조합" / "접근 X  수정 X  제출 X".
YES edge "예" continues to next diamond.
2. Diamond "제출을 완료했나요?"
YES edge "예" to blue terminal "기존 결과 조회" / "5개 조합" / "접근 O  수정 X  제출 X".
NO edge "아니요" continues to a central routing node "설문 운영 상태 확인" with "미응답 또는 작성 중".
3. This router MUST fan out into FIVE named state lanes:
LANE "생성": terminal "운영 전 접근 제한" / "2개 조합" / "접근 X  수정 X  제출 X".
LANE "예약": terminal "시작 전 접근 제한" / "2개 조합" / "접근 X  수정 X  제출 X".
LANE "진행": diamond "작성 중인가요?" with NO "아니요" leading to "신규 응답" / "1개 조합" / "접근 O  수정 O  제출 O", and YES "예" leading to "이어서 작성" / "1개 조합" / "접근 O  수정 O  제출 O".
LANE "일시정지": terminal "일시정지 안내" / "기존 답변 보존" / "2개 조합" / "접근 O  수정 X  제출 X".
LANE "종료": terminal "응답 접근 제한" / "기존 답변 보존" / "2개 조합" / "접근 X  수정 X  제출 X".
Important: completed target users bypass the five-lane state router and can view their submitted results in all five states. Do not route submitted users through the closed-state rejection. The mutually exclusive terminal counts are 15 + 5 + 2 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 30.

BOTTOM: a separate outlined narrow server revalidation flow, with its own request starting point:
"임시 저장 / 최종 제출 요청" -> "최신 상태와 참여 자격 재조회" -> diamond "요청한 동작이 허용되나요?"
YES "예" -> "저장 또는 제출 반영".
NO "아니요" -> "변경 거부" / "기존 답변 보존".
This is a second request-time check, not unconditional execution after a denied view. Visually separate this lower flow from the view-access routing above.

Composition: organize columns and levels carefully to fit this full topology. Make all five state lanes equally visible and clearly labeled. Connectors must not cross text or merge unrelated outcomes. Generous padding within nodes, but compact enough to show the complete policy in one image. Use manual line breaks for Korean text and for permission triples. All decision arrows require correct yes/no labels. Keep terminal counts readable. The full diagram will have a zoom/original link on mobile, so preserve the detailed branches instead of removing them.
edit_prompt: Edit this exact ERP survey flowchart with only one change: make ALL node outline strokes the SAME neutral gray as the normal non-rejection nodes. In particular, remove the red-tinted borders around the red rejection rectangles (운영 전 접근 제한, 시작 전 접근 제한, 응답 접근 제한, 변경 거부). Keep red rejection TEXT and pale red fills unchanged. Preserve every Korean word, arrow, O/X permission, count, node, topology, layout, canvas size and spacing exactly. Do not simplify, add or delete anything. This is a narrowly scoped border color correction.
